why: Both runs converged on the chapter's structure (two book parts, and 9.4/9.6 broken into the individually named methods and reactions NEET tests one at a time), so the decision is only about the ambiguous passages, and neither run is right on all of them. Run B is wrong on the Summary: P114 recaps the whole chapter and belongs nowhere near 'Amines as derivatives of ammonia', and B likewise forces the generic exercise prompts (P119 'How will you convert:', P121 'Write short notes on the following:', P123 'Accomplish the following conversions:', P125 'Give the structures of A, B and C') and the unattributable bare-equation answers P129-P131 onto whichever specific subtopic sits nearest, which is a guess a multi-part prompt cannot support. Run A's pooled chapter-wide bucket is the right home for those, kept here but renamed so it names the idea (multi-step conversions and chapter revision, a real NEET question type) rather than the location. Run A is wrong on P95: it is section 9.8, benzenediazonium chloride's own physical properties (colour, solubility, stability in the cold), a NEET-testable unit in its own right, so it gets its own subtopic under the book's heading 9.8 instead of being absorbed into 'nomenclature and stability' (A) or into 9.7 'Preparation' (B, which also mislabels its from_heading). Run B's split of 9.9 is adopted: Sandmeyer and Gattermann are named reactions NEET asks for by name, exactly the principle both runs applied to 9.4 and 9.6, so they must be separable from the general replacement reactions. P39 is kept with reduction of nitro compounds (A): it sits physically after the Hoffmann passages, so B's placement is the positional default, while A overrode that default, which only makes sense on a content read; this is the one placement I would most want a reviewer to re-check. All 131 passages P01-P131 are covered by at least one subtopic, verified against the final list; every passage ID is taken from the two runs' lists and none was invented.
note: Upstream data defect, not fixed here: the input's `headings` list duplicates numbers 9.5, 9.7, 9.8 and 9.9 because four end-of-chapter exercise prompts ('How will you convert:', 'Write short notes on the following:', 'Accomplish the following conversions:', 'Give the structures of A, B and C in the following reactions:') were captured as section headings by an earlier step. Both runs reported this and both compensated by using the real in-text section headings for `from_heading`; this list does the same. The owner should fix the heading extraction for CHE12-CH09. Two further uncertainties, both flagged for end-of-run review: (1) the boundary between subtopic 11 'Basic character of amines' and 12 'Structure-basicity relationship' -- run A put P51-P53 in 12, run B in 11; the evidence file carries no passage text, so I preserved A's boundary, and either placement keeps all passages covered. (2) P39's placement, as explained in `why`. The list has 25 subtopics, above the step's usual 4-15, for the reason both runs gave: two book parts plus sections 9.4, 9.6 and 9.9 that are themselves lists of individually named methods and reactions.
